blob_note: git_blob is Git's blob id of each file with CRLF normalised to LF; compare with: git ls-tree 4b03838800dcd4894f1e026461979bff1d985ca8 state/quality-trend/

definitions.row: one line of a source file: one artifact measured in one run
definitions.day: one distinct UTC date among the timestamps
definitions.segments: [value, number of consecutive measured rows holding it], in timestamp order
definitions.rows_with_numeric_fields: rows that carry citation_count, violation_count and compliance_rate (the 2026-05 baseline rows carry only deltas and labels)
